tool.description: Shift hue and scale saturation and lightness of an image in HSL space. hue is a degree shift (-360..360, 0 = no change); saturation and lightness are scale factors (0 = none/black, 1 = unchanged, >1 = more). E.g. saturation=0 makes it grayscale, hue=180 rotates colors to their complement. Returns a PNG. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

hue.description: Hue shift in degrees, -360 to 360 (0 = no change).

saturation.description: Saturation scale factor (0 = grayscale, 1 = unchanged, >1 = more vivid; max 4).

lightness.description: Lightness scale factor (0 = black, 1 = unchanged, >1 = brighter; max 4).
